_method: Duration of each verse's recitation, in milliseconds, read from the MP3 header of the file /read plays (assets/app.js qdReciteUrl, cdn.islamic.network): exact frame count from a Xing/Info or VBRI header when present, otherwise audio bytes x 8 / bitrate (constant bitrate). Only the first 16 KB of each file was fetched. A duration measures a reciter's performance, not the text. Verse-1 files may include the basmala; it is not separated. The CBR estimate ignores a trailing ID3v1 tag (128 bytes).
_source: cdn.islamic.network per-verse recitation files (Islamic Network); durations measured, no audio redistributed.
